title: Edgar Mitchell's Apollo 14 ESP experiment and Noetic society

tellings.quote: it's an experiment with the Swedish guy

plain: The Apollo 14 astronaut Edgar Mitchell is said to have run an experiment in extrasensory perception, sending thoughts by mind alone, during his 1971 trip to the Moon, and later to have started a society devoted to the study of consciousness. The Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn brings it up in passing, saying only that "it's an experiment with the Swedish guy."
